messages:
mike: noticing a sustained p99 tail on eu-west dedicated slice B-12 since ~08:03. GPU mem traffic spikes, KV cache miss rate climbing. CPU looks fine. possible noisy neighbor or egress choke?

anita: saw the same. tenant fast-gen ramped up large batched decodes at 08:02. PCIe DMA stall counters ticked up on node-7.

ryan: can someone run a quick probe? try: 
```
/bin/observe egress --slice B-12 --interval 5m --fields p99,packet_drops,pcie_stalls
```

jen: temporary mitigation options: 1) carve fast-gen into a fractional-slab with egress throttle (cheap isolation) 2) sticky-route them to a warm pool to avoid KV cold-starts 3) live migrate heavy pods off B-12 (higher disruption). tradeoffs: perf vs cost vs complexity.

infra-bot: migration job created: migr-1372 targeting fast-gen -> fractional-slab-03. ETA ~2m. :robot_face:

mike: i'd prefer a routing fallback first (sticky to warm pool) to avoid double warmup. migration only if throttling doesn't drop p99 under 200ms.

anita: sticky routing helps latency but egress saturation is the root cause; we should also enforce tenant-level qdisc shaping / burst controls to stop PCIe backpressure.

ryan: yesterday's burstlet experiment looked promising. config we used: 
```json
{"routing_policies": [{"match": "tenant=fast-gen", "egress_rate": "200mbps", "burst_credits": 3, "soft_affinity": true}]}
```

jen: adding a 60s prefetch/warmup for fractional carveouts would reduce KV miss storms during the handoff. low cost to try.

mike: @oncall please watch eu-west B-12: if p99 > 250ms for >2m or packet_drops > 0.5% trigger rollback and start migration. post short status in thread. :eyes: 

oncall: acknowledged, monitoring now. running alert rule infra.gpu.noise_quarantine.

anita: quick cost note — temporary carveout estimate: 3 dedicated slots for 48h ~ ~$1500 (ballpark). if this becomes frequent we should evaluate permanent fractional carve capacity per team.

ryan: long-term we should add a soft lane-affinity constraint to routing to avoid cross-AZ egress spikes and couple that with a lightweight tenant credit bucket (burstlet) system. reduces noisy neighbor surface without full dedicated pools.

mike: action items i) deploy tenant qdisc shaping rule to test on B-12 ii) enable sticky routing to warm-pool iii) keep migration job ready as fallback iv) finance ping for short-term carve cost. i'll open a tiny RFC if migration is executed.

jen: thanks — i'll implement warm-pool sticky routing and the 60s warmup. posting PR in eng-infra in ~20m.

anita: once stable i'll capture telemetry into the noise-quarantine dashboard so we can quantify freq and cost.

infra-bot: update: migr-1372 canceled (sticky routing applied). Monitoring window open for 10m.

mike: closing loop: initial p99 improved to ~130ms, packet drops back to baseline. keeping on watch. nice work team. :thumbsup:
